how: Snow is rare, but Experience Days lists a 90-minute ice-sculpting class in London on a 25 kg block, and the London Ice Sculpting Festival has run beginner classes.

The Firework Training School (linked to London-based Fantastic Fireworks) runs hobbyist and experience-day courses on firework chemistry and display firing near Luton; no London club for making fireworks was found.

Hunting needs arid strewn fields where dark stones stand out; the best areas are the US Southwest (Arizona's Franconia and Gold Basin fields) and Northwest Africa (Sahara, about 3.5 hours by air to Morocco).
A mobile FlowRider has been set up as a pop-up in London car parks (Finchley Road in 2012, one-hour sessions with wetsuit); no permanent venue was found and current availability is unconfirmed.
